reviews.text: Dr. Levy and Marcus were amazing with my cat, Doggy! He felt comfortable every time and warmed up to them quickly. Dr. Levy was able to help us fix a 2 year long ear issue that multiple vets across has been unable to help us with. She did an amazing job of figuring out the problem, finding ways to fix it, and explain EVERYTHING along the way. The team at Pet Dermatology Center is unmatched! They truly care about your animal and will do what it takes to get them the best care possible!

What an amazing experience. The Doctor and her team, as well as the front staff are
Exceptional. I felt better leaving there and I am so thankful.

We were blown away by the level of care our boy received, it was incredible!!! The office was so welcoming and calming, the entire team ensured we had everything we needed to provide the best care to our boy.
Dan and I appreciated how detailed Dr Levy was explaining all the options and the care for Bentleys current issues.   We would highly recommend Dr Levy and staff.
This was such a great experience, the staff is amazing and Dr. Levy took the time to really walk through next steps and reassure my concerns
Thank you for the review Karen!
What a thorough and informative veterinary visit! Beautiful facility and I appreciated the separate cat waiting area - that's rare. The follow-up visit summary was awesome.

We have been bringing our older dog to the Pet Dermatology Center for a few years now. From the start, Dr. Levy and her staff have been amazing. As our dog's health has changed they are quick to offer alternatives and solutions. They are extremely responsive and truly care about the healh of their patients with a goal of getting pets better as quickly as possible. They have truly felt like a partner during challenging times. Their expertise and level of service are worth every penny. Thank you!!!

l what I thought was I was bringing my cat to a specialist for his skin condition come to find out that they did pretty much everything that every vet I've been to with my cat which is three now I felt like I was hearing the same $$$  the other vets said shaking my head hope this works I'll keep you posted

Dr. Levy was amazing. She was very thorough in explaining everything to us, and made it super easy to understand what our cat is going through. We have a treatment plan in place and we are already seeing an improvement in our cat.

I appreciate the throughness of the explanations by Dr. Levy of our puppy's problems. She was spot on with her diagnosis and treatment plan. Her staff was gentle and caring, trying to put Frankie at ease during the visit. I would highly recommend this derm practice.
Whatever you guys are doing back there, you made it look effortless! What a phenomenal team. So glad to have you! 🫶🏻

I was very impressed with this clinic.  My rescue cat has been suffering with itchy ears since I adopted him.  My Vet recommended this clinic and I am so glad they did.   Dr. Levy spent an hour with us narrowing down possibilities, gave me suggestions, medications and a course of treatment to try to reduce allergens….
I begin the treatment today, we will see how successful it is, but her examination of my cat, the way she knelt down to put him at ease, shows her concern and compassion for her patients.  I was very impressed.  Would definitely recommend.

I really appreciate the entire team's efforts in making the experience a positive one and taking such good care of my cat. During our initial consultation, Dr. Levy helped me to better understand allergies overall and, most importantly, come up with a realistic plan that would work best without it feeling overwhelming or complicated. I feel much more confident about my cat's allergies now and am very grateful!

We had a great visit. Staff and doctor were all very friendly, informative, and caring. I left our appointment with lots of information and a plan for my dog. Follow up email was very detailed, which helped me feel knowledgeable about my dog's allergies.
The entire team is very friendly, compassionate and knowledgeable! Dr. Levy is fantastic, she takes the time to listen, explain and comes up with realistic plans for our furry babies.

I can't say enough good things about this dermatologist. My Bassett hound has been struggling with allergies, and it's been tough seeing him so uncomfortable. From the moment we came in, they were patient, thorough, and truly cared about helping him feel better.
< br />
< br />They took the time to explain everything clearly and came up with a plan to get his allergies under control. You can tell they genuinely love animals and want the best for them. I'm really hopeful that with their help, my dog will finally start feeling like himself again.
< br />
< br />Highly recommend to anyone dealing with pet allergies—this place truly goes above and beyond.

Just one step into the Pet Dermatology offices in Old City, Philadelphia, and you immediately know that you have brought your furry loved one to the best facility in the area for the care, treatment and compassion they deserve. This center is the most comfortable and supportive facility of its kind not only for your pet, but for you as well. Dr. Britt Levy is an accomplished expert who uses are experience and case studies to suggest treatment options when even the best veterinarians run out of solutions. I highly recommend visiting today.
The whole staff was very helpful and friendly. Dr. Levy was very knowledgeable and took a great history of our somewhat complex case. I am confident she will help us continue to find solutions!
Super kind, helpful folks, never a fun day to wrangle the cats, but knowing I'm going here makes it far less stressful
Thank you Brianna!
Dr. Levy and her team are wonderful! They took time to discuss options for our girl. She answered all of our questions. Highly recommend!

Came here for a restart with a new team. They were fabulous at our initial consult. Gave lots of education and reasoning behind why they recommend certain treatments. I felt very included in decisions made. My dog tends to be a bit more on the nervous side at the vet did great at their center and towards the end of her appt was laying down ready for a nap. Highly recommend!

Dr. Levy and team have been a great partner in a referral setting for out patients over the years. It is amazing to know that they care about our patients as much as we do and will provide them with the very best care.
Very friendly and helpful

Updated review after treatment:
After years and years of chronic ear infections and skin issues/infections, my regular vet said they had exhausted all options to help my dog, Patsy, feel better. She had been on monthly allergy shots for years, which helped improve some symptoms but never actually resolved the issues.

Dr. Levy and the team were incredibly dealing with Patsy in her office visits - she’s incredibly anxious and was really nervous. They were able to quickly assess her and build a treatment plan tailored to her issues.  After ensuring treatment was right and working, Dr. Levy also switched us to virtual visits so that Patsy doesn’t have to endure the stress of going into the office.

Patsy is doing so well on the new medications! She's like a brand new dog - she's happy, frisky, and playful. She even did zoomies not long ago for the FIRST TIME EVER (she's 11!)! She’s finally completely free of ear and skin infections after so many years of struggling with them. I cannot thank Dr. Levy and Pet Dermatology Center enough for giving my old gal relief and a newfound pep in her puppy step!

Original review: All of the staff were knowledgeable and helpful. It was great to see such compassion and support from the team dealing with my extremely anxious and scared dog. And they diagnosed the heart of the issue quickly and came up with both a short and long-term game plan to address my dog’s chronic skin and ear issues. I highly recommend!

Pet Dermatology Center is truly amazing.   After watching my cat suffer from allergies for years, Dr. Levy was able to narrow down her allergies and suggested a course of action.  She also indicated that a prior allergy test was most likely full of false positive results and suggested a new one and a new lab.  Looking forward to getting the results she will formulate a new medical regime.  Dr. Levy and her assistant Marcus was great.  Smart, caring and knowledgeable.
Thank you so much John!
they are very caring and treat our cat with the highest regard. thank you. 😸
Everyone was helpful, pleasant and knowledgeable. Appreciate that we can coordinate care with our local vet.

I was so impressed! Our doggo was obviously anxious and scared, but everyone there made me feel at ease and lessened the stress to our dog. Dr. Levy was incredibly knowledgeable and kind. I also appreciated how transparent she and the team were about prices upfront. We're very grateful to have been referred here by our primary vet!!!

nice clean place, nice staff, nice that DaVinci was allowed to sit on the furniture!!! Dr Levy was great-she explained what she was going to be doing, then did as she said. She took the time to listen to me and asked great questions. She explained her diagnosis and the ways we can treat it.
Very satisfied customer(s) here! Thank you-

Cannot say enough positive things about my visit. Dr. Levy is incredibly knowledgeable and eased my anxieties about various treatments. She was gentle and patient with my anxious dog and made us feel so comfortable.

I love the atmosphere they create in order to have a quiet, clean and safe space for us. The team from the front desk to the assistants/technicians have a calm yet friendly disposition which makes the experience stress free. I like Dr. Levy's approach. I have already referred a friend. Loved the time she spent with us, the thorough exam, her review of Baileys records prior to our visit. Her explanations and advice are great. Her post follow up report was prompt and thorough. A plus all around!

The whole experience at Pet Dermatology was something I have never experienced before, caring , calming, helpful, very knowledgeable. I can not say enough good things about everyone that I spoke with/had interactions with on 11/13. Highly Recommend!
Dr. Levy and her staff are friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. Great customer service and medical attention for my dog.

Excellent care from both the veterinarian and the staff.
I got a complete explanation of the process for healing my pet and the time frames for results. There was no confusion or questions unanswered when we left.

Everyone was very nice.The doctor was very helpful and explained everything we would need to do for chinook.

I scheduled an appointment with Dr. Levy for my 13-year-old female Chihuahua / Jack Russel Mix (Sandi). She had several large areas of open skin that unfortunately biopsied as Erythema Multiforme. It was severely impacting her quality of life. I turned to the Pet Dermatology Center to help manage her care moving forward.

Location: For anyone coming from NJ-the drive is easy + two paid parking lots are present within eyesight of the Pet Dermatology Center. The attendant at the open corner lot is friendly, and parking is easy to navigate. Parking is $14 for and 90 minutes payable via card at a kiosk. The lot has amble room to stretch your and your pets' legs after a long car ride.

Medications/Pricing: Medications were filled in the office for reasonable prices. An online pharmacy was offered for refills + prescription diet. The reuseable shopping bag and stickers were a thoughtful addition to the first visit. All pricing was transparent + reasonable for the level of attention and detail provided. Deposits are taken to secure each appointment; frequent appointment reminders are provided.

Office: The office itself is clean + well maintained. A clean bathroom is available for clients with plenty of hand soap and paper towels. Complementary drinks and animal treats are offered for. The waiting area is large and comfortable.

Dr. Levy + Staff: They are EXCELLENT. You can tell when someone takes pride in the work that they do- the staff at the Pet Dermatology Center are simply the best. During Sandi's initial appointment Dr. Levy spent time going thru details of her past medical history to get a completed picture of the steps needed to move forward. She was already aware of Sandi's pre-existing conditions. She took the time to develop a plan to get Sandi into remission. Sandi had noticeable improvement within days after her initial visit; both in temperament and healing of affected areas. Her disease is not easy to manage, and it is possible that relapses will present in the future.

I highly recommend the Pet Dermatology Center. Dr. Levy has given me more time with my feral old girl, and for that I am forever grateful. Sandi sores are fully healed, and we are moving forward with a plan of hopeful remission.
Courteous, and professional staff. Dr. L is very thorough and compassionate. Overall, a very nice experience with initial visit, and followups. SnowBall (caine) is doing well. ❤️‍🩹
Always careful and thorough treatment for our cat, Zeus. Thank you!
Excellent services..staff great...parking out front...Dr.explained detailed plan for our dog..

We have had a long journey with our long haired German Shepherd. At the age of 2 she started having allergies which were treated with typical meds. Then her hair started to fall out rapidly. We have moved around a lot in those months so we figure different environments different allergies. Every vet said environmental allergies. We moved here to NJ a year ago still trying to treat skin infections and allergies. Now at age 4, our new vet recommended Dr Levy have a look at her. Low and behold she told us not only did she have allergies but an auto immune disease that affects the oil glands with the hair follicles. Now, yes this assessment was not cheap, but for us, worth it. She has been on meds and takes her baths with specific shampoos and in four months the transformation was astounding. She did have a minor setback when the fall allergies kicked in, but Dr Levy tweaked her meds and upped the amount of baths and now she's back on track. She explains everything and takes the time to listen to you. The staff always get back to me with answers to my questions and concerns outside of appointments. Our girl is now 4 1/2 and we are on our way to hopefully having a thick, shiny and long coat. Like I said it's a journey, not cheap, but for us, worth it.
